claims: The published outright prohibition list contains 81 names and does not include India.
The restriction test covers citizenship, residence, and prolonged predominant trading location.
TradeDay describes separate Funded Sim limitations for Germany and Canada outside Ontario.
Funded onboarding uses broker, clearing-firm and Riseworks KYC/AML with government ID and address evidence.
TradeDay publishes credit and debit card billing through NMI or Braintree, plus Google Pay, Apple Pay and PayPal.
Riseworks offers bank-wire and crypto payout methods after invitation.
Published fees are $15 for an international bank wire, $2.50 plus gas for L1 crypto, and no TradeDay fee for L2 crypto.
Nine unique product-size combinations across 18 platform cards display dollar-denominated promotional monthly fees from $59 to $225.

unresolvedConflicts: No Indian checkout, KYC approval, payout-provider invitation, bank-wire receipt, crypto receipt, or INR settlement was independently tested.
The displayed fees are tied to a 55%-off campaign rather than verified stable list prices.
First-party pages conflict on whether a funded-stage KYC failure produces a refund.
